variants.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: polished ecommerce product photograph with a genuine transparent alpha background.
Primary request: Turn the supplied SeaRealm flat wrapper artwork into ONE realistic sealed foil trading-card booster pack. The input is exact packaging artwork to preserve, not loose inspiration. The central upright panel is the FRONT; the barcode/copyright and rotated paragraphs are BACK panels wrapping around, not extra front panels.
Style/materials: premium photographic realism, thin sealed printed laminated foil containing nine cards, gentle natural bulge, fine horizontal crimped seals at top and bottom, subtle edge seams. Restrained realistic foil sheen that never obscures the design.
Composition: landscape 4:3 canvas, approximately 2000 by 1500 pixels; one entire portrait-oriented pack centered at roughly 76 percent of canvas height, ample transparent margin on every side. Almost front-facing with only a gentle 8-degree three-quarter turn showing a very slim right edge, vertical upright pack. No crop. Soft upper-left studio light and delicate contact shadow with transparent surroundings.
Preserve invariant artwork: reproduce the original white SeaRealm script logo and its blue-and-white wave underline precisely, original TRADING CARD GAME subtitle, marine image, colors, positions, typography and the set icon. All visible front words must be exactly 'SeaRealm', 'TRADING CARD GAME', 'DIVE PACK', '9 Additional Game Cards', with original small trademark symbols. Don't add set names, captions, labels or extra claims. Keep relative artwork placement faithful; the print wraps naturally onto the packet. The central front panel remains the only artwork on the front.
Avoid: dimensions, measurement arrows, ruler lines, cutting guides, unfolded paper flaps, extra packs, cards spilling out, props, floor plane, background, watermark, fake checkerboard, invented logos, changed animals, inflated snack-bag proportions, excessive glare.
Front-specific preservation: blue underwater background, the same large facing great white shark, the mint coral icon next to DIVE PACK low on the front, and the white bottom card-count line. Keep the shark illustrated exactly as supplied rather than replacing it with another shark or realistic wildlife photo.

Preserve the existing lettering and black/blue composition.
